turns.prompt_text: the dishwasher disposal is not powering
turns.response_html: Check the reset button on the bottom of the disposal unit and ensure the circuit breaker hasn't tripped. You should also verify that the unit is plugged into a functional outlet and check for any internal jams using an Allen wrench in the bottom center port.
